$Comment: The health, in percent of its whole, at or under which a foe takes every hit of its holder as a weak spot (8 is a foe at 8% health or less). Base 0: no foe is low enough until something raises it. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat. Min 0, unlike most stats, because it is a health threshold: no foe sits below no health, so a lower total would mean only what 0 already means.
